prompts.default: Game environment raster asset. Rounded chunky hand-painted cartoon, soft dark purple-brown outlines, ONLY 2–3 clear flat shade levels, simple broad shapes, small brief highlights. Match chibi fantasy actors. NO photographic texture, noise, micro-detail, airbrush shading, black outlines, text, labels, frames or watermark. Materials: blue-gray block masonry with broad sparse moss patches; local palette: muted mist-green wet stone, sparse moss, subtle bell-shaped details. Seamless square flat stone TOP SURFACE texture, full bleed, orthographic top-down. Broad calm planes with a few soft dark cracks. No raised objects, isometric tile, border, shadow, vignette, plants, walls or perspective. Every edge matches opposite edge. Muted medium-dark local stone color.
